description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging with potential chaining to other LogNodes, enabling flexible log handling within Android applications.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility to implement the LogNode interface, allowing logs to be forwarded through a chain of LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable. Forwards the log to the next LogNode if present.
